Methods

@IsTest
private static void allMethodsReturnValidIntegersTest()

Tests all utility methods return valid integers. Verifies that none of the methods return null or invalid values.

@IsTest
private static void consistentValuesWithinTransactionTest()

Tests that all SystemUtils methods return consistent values within a transaction. Verifies that multiple calls to the same method return the same value.

@IsTest
private static void getAvailableBatchJobsMaxLimitTest()

Tests getAvailableBatchJobs() method when no jobs are scheduled. Verifies that the method returns the maximum limit when no jobs exist.

@IsTest
private static void getAvailableBatchJobsTest()

Tests getAvailableBatchJobs() method. Verifies that the method returns a valid integer representing available batch job slots.

@IsTest
private static void getAvailableDmlLimitAfterDmlTest()

Tests getAvailableDmlLimit() method after performing DML operations. Verifies that the available DML limit decreases after inserting records.

@IsTest
private static void getAvailableDmlLimitNearLimitTest()

Tests getAvailableDmlLimit() edge case with maximum DML operations. Verifies that the method correctly reports when approaching DML limits.

@IsTest
private static void getAvailableDmlLimitTest()

Tests getAvailableDmlLimit() method. Verifies that the method returns the correct number of available DML rows.

@IsTest
private static void getAvailableQueueableLimitInTestContextTest()

Tests getAvailableQueueableLimit() method behavior in test context. Verifies that queueable limit changes are tracked correctly.

@IsTest
private static void getAvailableQueueableLimitTest()

Tests getAvailableQueueableLimit() method. Verifies that the method returns the correct number of available queueable jobs.
